tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, and agile teams.
keywords_missing: SAP Commerce Cloud implementation methodology specific to REHAU internal processes

cover_en.subject: Application: Application Consultant SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Application Consultant SAP Commerce role at REHAU. With over 5 years of professional experience as a backend developer specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in platform development and integrations.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: OCC & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built RESTful APIs for Headless Commerce integrations and PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Data & Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and managed platform operations through the Hybris Admin Console (HAC).

cover_en.gap: While my background is centered on SAP Commerce development and backend engineering, I am keen to learn any specific internal REHAU methodologies required for this consultancy role.
cover_en.logistics: I am currently based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving a notice period ending on 15 December 2026, with my earliest start date being 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Application Consultant SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich auf die Position als Application Consultant SAP Commerce bei REHAU. Als Backend-Entwicklerin mit über 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java
bullets.text: Entwicklung von Backend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement.

bullets.label: OCC & REST APIs
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie RESTful APIs für Headless Commerce und PWA-Frontends.

bullets.label: Integrationen
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines unter Verwendung von Profisee, Hotfoldern und DataHub zur Katalogsynchronisation.

bullets.label: Plattformbetrieb
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) sowie Plattformverwaltung über die Hybris Admin Console (HAC).

cover_de.gap: Sollten spezifische unternehmensinterne Methodiken von REHAU gefragt sein, bin ich hoch motiviert, diese schnellstmöglich zu erlernen.
cover_de.logistics: Ich befinde mich in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis und bin derzeit in einer Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026. Mein frühestes Startdatum ist der 16.12.2026. Über ein persönliches Gespräch freue ich mich sehr.

tailoring.why_company: REHAU is a leading global manufacturing brand with advanced digital platforms. I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to help optimize and scale REHAU's enterprise e-commerce solutions, contributing strong backend development, API integration, and performance tuning skills.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, deep Java and Spring expertise, and a proven track record in enterprise e-commerce integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I noticed your SAP Commerce openings at REHAU. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I build scalable backend solutions, OCC APIs, and integrations. I have a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Application Consultant SAP Commerce - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Application Consultant SAP Commerce position at REHAU. With over 5 years of professional experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development across enterprise projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and system integrations.

My complete CV and cover letter are attached. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
